lines.t: I spent so many nights wide awake
Trying to choose to find a path to take
I felt a worry in my heart I couldn't shake
Cause I didn't know a choice to make
And when I did I knew I found something true
Something worthwhile and right out of the blue
And my worry turned into a smile
You're the path I want to take
You're the choice I want to make
But now I know your love is pure
In your arms I'm safe, I'm sound
Fear turns to peace, my worries bound
Because I know your love's forever by my side
The one in whose love I'll always stay
In every storm, in every trial
You're there with me all the while
I'll reach you the only way
My love, I'll be running to you
Yeah, who's sure to you I'll remain true
With you my heart will always stay Yahushua, the only way
